description: This file defines various type guards and type aliases for handling different kinds of TransferPayload objects and their specific variations (Decrypted, Encrypted, Deleted). It includes import statements for utility functions and related payload types, as well as functions to determine the specific type of a TransferPayload object based on its properties.

methods.name: export function isDecryptedTransferPayload(payload: TransferPayload): payload is DecryptedTransf/ isDecryptedTransferPayload
methods.description: Type guard that checks if a TransferPayload is a DecryptedTransferPayload by verifying if 'content' is an object.

methods.name: export function isEncryptedTransferPayload(payload: TransferPayload): payload is EncryptedTransf/ isEncryptedTransferPayload
methods.description: Type guard that checks if a TransferPayload is an EncryptedTransferPayload by verifying if 'content' is a string and present in the payload.

methods.name: export function isErrorDecryptingTransferPayload(payload: TransferPayload): payload is Encrypted/ isErrorDecryptingTransferPayload
methods.description: Type guard that checks if a TransferPayload is an EncryptedTransferPayload with 'errorDecrypting' set to true.

methods.name: export function isDeletedTransferPayload(payload: TransferPayload): payload is DeletedTransferPa/ isDeletedTransferPayload
methods.description: Type guard that checks if a TransferPayload is marked as deleted by verifying the 'deleted' property.

methods.name: export function isCorruptTransferPayload(payload: TransferPayload): boolean { isCorruptTransferPayload
methods.description: Function that determines if a TransferPayload is corrupt based on its 'uuid', 'deleted', 'content', and 'content_type' properties.

ctags.name: invalidDeletedState
ctags.pattern: /^  const invalidDeletedState = payload.deleted === true && payload.content != undefined$/
